variants.v3: Title. Level N (label). Description. Department. Faculty.

3D.fallback: the rules with alpha = 0 and no beta

3G.tauCandidates: derivation half's top-1 cosine at p90 and p95 by nearest rank (the ceil(p*n)-th smallest) and its maximum, each + 1e-6, distinct values
3G.selection: the largest candidate that passes every dev condition
3G.fallback: the next smaller candidate that passes on dev

3H.fallback: the other prereq semantics with the same raw/stripped choice

selection.general: dev primary mean ΔnDCG@10 vs the shipped ranker
selection.targeted: mean ΔnDCG@10 over the declared targets' answerable queries, among points with overall Δ ≥ 0
selection.ties: equal to 3 decimals → fewest changed parameters, then the smallest change, then grid order
selection.prereq: mean ΔnDCG@10 over dev queries with a parsed prereq intent; (i) wins ties to 3 decimals
selection.rawStripped: stripped unless raw's constraint-block mean nDCG@10 is higher by ≥ 0.05 and raw's overall dev Δ ≥ 0
